rationale: Preserve every existing themeOfBest priority; extend its describeMove gain stage with the unchanged trapped-piece collection proof, then try the supplementary deflection line reader, before defensiveMove and phase. The pin does not itself rank the two new words.
availabilityDefinition: A new word is available when its independent candidate emits that word for the same puzzle, after the existing higher-priority tactics. Both means best-deflection emits deflection and best-trapped emits trappedPiece. This does not count raw findings hidden by an earlier tactic.
selectionDefinition: Use the first available word in priority; if neither is available, use the pinned label. Assert this composition on every paired puzzle.
bootstrap: Paired puzzles with replacement; original set size per draw; Mulberry32 seed restarted for each set; same draws for both indicators; sorted endpoints floor(0.025 B) and floor(0.975 B).
multiplicity: No multiple-comparison correction; same fixed rule as the independent candidates.
decision: Keep only when both app and heldout pass. A failed combined test does not support this combined port. Overlap counts are descriptive and add no threshold.
priorEvidence: Individual held-out outcomes have already been observed. This tests the requested fixed combination on those same sets; no search over priorities is allowed.
